text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
RZECZPOSPOLITA
- Poland's year-on-year inflation was between 18.4-18.6 percent in 1996, Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said.

- The government is ready to provide credit guarantees to plants which made construction materials based on the recently banned asbestos, which will allow them to acquire non-asbestos technologies, the economy ministry said.
- The capital group of the listed Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych (BIG) bank has offered to buy the remaining 31.94 percent stake in the Bank Gdanski bank from the state treasury.

- Mostostal Krakow industrial construction firm, which received an International Standards Organisation (ISO)-9002 quality certificate in November 1995, will soon be listed on the Warsaw bourse, the company said.
- The listed Budimex construction firm will carry out six contracts for the Coca Cola bottlers in Belarus and Ukraine worth $1.5 million, Budimex said.
- The listed Bank Rozwoju Exportu (BRE) export development bank's net profit in December 1996 was 8.9 million zlotys, the bank said.

- The ZPW Grajewo chipboard plant will double its output by investing over 110 million zlotys in facility development this year. The plant, in Grajewo, should increase its market share to 25 percent, the management said.

- Germany's Daimler Benz buys leather upholstery for cars made on order from the Grodzisk Wielkopolski based Inter Groclin Auto firm. The upholstery maker received the International Standards Organisation (ISO)-9002 quality certificate in July 1995.
NOWA EUROPA
- Poland's car sales this year will exceed last year's results, a survey by the PBS polling institute said. Car dealers sold 350,000 new cars in 1996.
- Poland's biggest sea ports reloaded 30.5 million tonnes of commodities in 1996, which showed a decline by 700,000 tonnes compared with the previous year, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.

- Italy's Franchi mechanical engineering firm will make steel accessories for rolling stock in cooperation with the Miedzyrzecze Podlaskie-based ZREMB mechanical engineering firm, ZREMB's president Andrzej Makowski said. Franchi will invest $1 million in the new project.
- The coming extraordinary shareholders meeting of the Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH) will vote on a convertible bond issue to increase the bank's share capital by 9.9 million zlotys, BPH said.
GAZETA WYBORCZA
- The listed Stomil Olsztyn tyre maker has reported a 400 percent sales growth of the Kormoran type winter tyres this season, the company said.
- The National Investment Fund (NFI) Fortuna reported a net loss of 25.5 million zlotys in the first three quarters of 1996, Fortuna's spokesman Krzysztof Turowski said.
- Italy's Fiat automaker has closed down its Polish property development subsidiary Fiat Engineering Poland, the Fiat Poland director Maciej Brzozowski said.
ZYCIE
- Poland's railway engine drivers plan to strike as of next Saturday as pay agreements negotiated last year were broken by the government, their trade union board said.
- Around 42 percent of adult Poles are interested in buying mobile phones, a survey by the PBS polling institute said.
PARKIET
- Warta insurance firm's annual net profit last year was 17.4 million zlotys and it is expected to grow to 25 million zlotys this year, the company's forecast said.
- Bank Handlowy's Capital Operations Centre (BH COK) recommended buying shares of the Elektrobudowa construction firm in a report dated December 6.
